name: creative-practice
title: Make space for a creative practice
introCopy: Small rituals make space for ideas.
headline:
Make room
for an idea.

bodyBeats.body: Bring a notebook. Choose a quiet corner.

bodyBeats.heading:
Begin with
one object.
bodyBeats.body: Look closely. Sketch the shapes you notice.

bodyBeats.heading:
Leave space
for the next idea.
bodyBeats.body: Keep a page open for something you want to revisit.
Choose a simple practice you would like to return to.
